verdict.rationale: Lambda documents an S3-compatible adapter for its filesystems allowing rclone/s5cmd to move data in/out, plus a REST Cloud API for programmatic resource management, giving concrete transfer tooling. However this is filesystem-specific (not a full S3-compatible object storage endpoint for all data), and there's no dedicated cloud-storage sync product or broader documented data pipeline. Missing for 10: native S3-compatible object storage service (not just an adapter), documented sync/replication tooling, and independent hands-on verification of transfer performance/reliability.
